items.note: The opening line states the decision: keep using Postgres with pgvector, or adopt a dedicated vector database.
States about 5 million embeddings at 1536 dimensions, growing about 1 million per quarter.
States a budget under $500 per month.
States that queries must filter by tenant_id (multi-tenant).
Says to compare at most 4 options: pgvector plus up to 3 dedicated vector databases.
Asks for a comparison table with sources cited, then one clear recommendation.
Says to use only material from the last 12 months. That is stricter than 'prefer', but it matches the 12-month window the person asked for.
The plan is a wide survey of all 4 options, then a deep look at the top 2.
